meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: China PR v Haiti | Group D | FIFA Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023, USA v Thailand | Group F | FIFA Women's World Cup France 2019™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Brazil v France | France 98, FACTS: Italy v France | Germany 2006
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
